title: 第194章 不得人心法大王
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“还有事？”

发现尼可一直看着自己，王言忍不住问道。

对方欲言又止的神色，明摆着就是还有事情找他啊。

尼可点点头，声音在王言脑海中响起：“可以带我去一趟你们发现克莱奥瑟莉妮的地方吗？”

“嗯？去雷图礁？为什么？”王言没有立马答应下来，而是反问了一句。

尼可倒是没有隐

这句话让吴明心中咯噔一下，之前高进说的话，他全都当成是天方夜谭，甚至有可能是高进在神经紧张的情况下看到的幻觉。

一大批人，数量至少数千人，围在四面八方，将这座矮山，团团围住。

算起来，中枢之所以为中枢，因为中枢不论是开化程度或者繁荣程度都比环绕在四周的北疆、南域、西界、东境强上许多。

赤罴，幻兽中属于最低阶的物种，攻击单一容易呈疲态，正好是鬼通他们最好的猎物。

已经发生在了过去的事情，即便自己进入到了那个时空，也无法改变吗？

"Anything else?"

Realizing that Nico had been looking at him, Wang Yan couldn't help but ask.

The other party's hesitant look on his face clearly meant that he still had something to ask for.

Nico nodded, and his voice sounded in Wang Yan's mind: "Can you take me to the place where you found Cleoselini?"

"Huh? Going to Leitu Reef? Why?" Wang Yan did not agree immediately, but asked a question.

Nico didn't hide it

This sentence made Wu Ming's heart skip a beat. Everything Gao Jin said before was regarded as fantasy. It might even be an illusion that Gao Jin saw when he was nervous.

A large number of people, numbering at least several thousand, surrounded the low mountain from all directions.

To sum up, the reason why the center is called the center is because the center is much more civilized and prosperous than the surrounding northern, southern, western and eastern territories.

Red scorpions are the lowest-level species among phantom beasts. They easily become fatigued after a single attack. They happen to be the best prey for Ghost and the others.

What happened in the past, can't you change it even if you enter that time and space?
